style.backgroundSystem: alternating eucalyptus-sage #A9C4B0 fields easing to a deeper #8FAD97 foot band, and warm off-white #EDEDE9 paper plates; depth on the plates comes only from stacked concentric #DDE0DC and #CFD5D0 discs, never from gradients or props
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight #3B3B39 line icons drawn from the music-note family inside hairline circles, one small thin-line double music-note glyph at the top-right corner of every plate, hairline #3B3B39 leader lines with dot terminators, hairline grid dividers, one large thin-line #FFFFFF treble-clef glyph and one hairline wavy staff ornament as the set's recurring ornaments; no filled, duotone or 3D icons
style.lightingSystem: neutral soft studio key at about 5200K from the front-left with a large fill, low contrast wrap, an always-present soft contact shadow under every product, one faint mirrored reflection on the glossy #8FAD97 strip, and raking soft side light for the texture close-ups
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh botanical sage audio ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of an eucalyptus-sage field #A9C4B0 easing to a deeper #8FAD97, a warm off-white paper plate #EDEDE9, one deep-moss pill badge #4C6B57, ink-grey text #3B3B39, pale bean-green discs #DDE0DC and #CFD5D0, and pure #FFFFFF type on the green fields; neutral soft studio key at about 5200K from the front-left with a large fill, low-contrast wrap, an always-present soft contact shadow under every product, one faint mirrored reflection on the glossy #8FAD97 strip and raking soft side light for texture close-ups; modern geometric sans-serif with short two-line Chinese headlines wrapped in corner brackets, one small uppercase Latin eyebrow above one hairline rule at the plate corner and one deep-moss #4C6B57 pill badge behind every short callout; alternating #A9C4B0 green fields and #EDEDE9 off-white plates, depth built only from stacked concentric #DDE0DC and #CFD5D0 discs, one hairline wavy staff ornament and one small thin-line double music-note glyph at the top-right corner of each plate; shared icon language of thin single-weight #3B3B39 line icons from the music-note family inside hairline circles with hairline leader lines and dot terminators, no filled or duotone icons; matte #EDEDE9 paper plates, a narrow glossy #8FAD97 reflection strip and one matte wood-grain #8B6A4F plank as the only surfaces; stable product scale and centring, the two earbuds always a matched left-and-right pair with the case, shell finish exactly as in the reference with no recolouring; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented spec numbers, no warped straight lines or distorted concentric discs.
noDrift: no invented spec numbers or certifications

style.presentationRules: one identical semi-in-ear earbud-and-case silhouette across the set, the two buds always shown as a matched left-and-right pair with the case, hinge-open shots always read from the rear so the hinge and wells are legible, shell finish kept exactly as in the reference with no recolouring, stable scale and centring between screens
style.surfaceSystem: matte #EDEDE9 paper plates carrying stacked pale #DDE0DC and #CFD5D0 concentric discs, a narrow glossy #8FAD97 reflection strip at the foot of the green fields, one matte wood-grain #8B6A4F plank for the tilt-shift soundstage
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; two-line #FFFFFF Chinese headlines on the sage fields and #3B3B39 headlines on the off-white plates, one small uppercase Latin eyebrow above one hairline rule at the plate corner, one deep-moss #4C6B57 pill badge behind every short callout, three-layer copy only and Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」 and carried as placeholders
